content.title: Content Studio — AI-powered content creation
content.desc: Try it: click "Create Content", pick a type (e.g. Instagram post), describe your product in one sentence — AI generates ready-to-publish text. No marketing experience needed.

campaigns.title: Campaigns — coordinate your marketing actions
campaigns.desc: Try it: create a campaign like "Product Launch" or "Black Friday". Then add content and emails to it — everything stays organized in one place with progress tracking.

email.title: Email Marketing — grow and reach your audience
email.desc: Start here: go to Settings → Email Accounts and connect your email. Then import subscribers or add them manually, and send your first newsletter.

checklists.title: Checklists — step-by-step marketing task lists
checklists.desc: Try it: click "Create Checklist" and choose a type — e.g. "Product Launch" or "Social Media Plan". AI generates a step-by-step task list you can follow and check off.

documents.title: Documents — your marketing plans and strategies
documents.desc: Try it: click "Create Document" and ask AI to write a marketing plan, brand guidelines, or competitor analysis. Great for long-form strategy docs.

analytics.title: Analytics — see how your marketing is performing
analytics.desc: Start here: copy the tracking snippet code and add it to your website's HTML. After that, you'll see visitor stats, page views, and content engagement here.

seo.title: SEO — help customers find you on Google
seo.desc: Try it: click "Add Keyword" and enter a phrase your customers might search for (e.g. "best project management tool"). AI will analyze it and suggest how to rank higher.

experiments.title: A/B Testing — find out what works best
experiments.desc: Try it: create an experiment with two versions of a headline, email subject, or CTA button. The system will show both to users and tell you which one performs better.

sequences.title: Email Sequences — automated welcome & nurture emails
sequences.desc: Try it: create a sequence and add emails with delays — e.g. welcome email on Day 0, a helpful tip on Day 3, a special offer on Day 7. Emails are sent automatically after someone subscribes.

competitors.title: Competitors — keep an eye on the competition
competitors.desc: Try it: click "Add Competitor" and enter their website URL. Track what they're doing so you can find gaps and differentiate your product.

calendar.title: Content Calendar — plan your publishing schedule
calendar.desc: This shows all your content with scheduled dates in a monthly view. To use it, create content in Content Studio and set a publish date — it will appear here automatically.

finances.title: Finances — track your project income and expenses
finances.desc: Try it: click "Add Record" to log an expense or income. You can use different currencies — exchange rates are fetched automatically. See your P&L at a glance with charts and summaries.
